comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej
 
  • Classes in comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej used by comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej
    Class
    Description
    ClassTelemetryListener
    Listens for BlueJ class events (state changes, renames and removals) and turns each one into a command.
    CompileTelemetryListener
    Listens for compilations the student starts and records their start, each error, and success or failure.
    EditorAttacher
    Attaches exactly one EditDocumentListener to each class editor, and remembers which classes already have one.
    InvocationTelemetryListener
    Listens for finished program runs (method calls and object creation from BlueJ) and records how each run ended.
    ListenerContext
    Holds the objects every BlueJ listener needs, so each listener takes one parameter instead of four.
    PackageTelemetryListener
    Listens for BlueJ projects opening and closing.
